sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajesh Singh Chauhan,J.
1. Heard Sri Jahangir Haider, learned counsel for the revisionist, learned A.G.A. appearing for the State and Harendra Pratap, learned counsel appearing for private-opposite party.

2. By means of this revision, the revisionist has prayed following main reliefs:-
"It is therefore most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to set aside the impugned order dated 12.06.2024 passed by learned Special Judge (POCSO Act)/Additional District and Sessions Judge, District Ghaziabad, so far as it relates to rejection of application filed by the revisionist under Section 311 Cr.P.C. dated 07.06.2024 for recalling the PW-2/victim in Criminal Case No. 203 of 2022 (State vs. Adil) arising out of Case Crime No. 334 of 2022 under Sections 376 Adil vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 10 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/183136685/
1 (AB), 377, I.P.C. and Section 5M/6 POCSO Act, Police Station Tronica City, District Ghaziabad, otherwise the revisionist shall suffer irreperable loss and injury which cannot be compensated in any terms.
It is further prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to stay the effect and operation of the impugned order dated 12.06.2024 passed by learned Special Judge (POCSO) Act)/Additional District and Sessions Judge, District Ghaziabad and also to stay the further proceedings of Criminal Case No. 203 of 2022 (State vs. Adil) arising out of Case Crime No. 334 of 2022 under Sections 376 (AB),
377, I.P.C. and Section 5M/6 POCSO Act, Police Station Tronica City, District Ghaziabad, pending before learned Special Judge (POCSO Act)/Additional District and Sessions Judge, District Ghaziabad, during the pendency of the present revision before this Hon'ble Court, otherwise the revisionist shall suffer irreparable loss and injury which cannot be compensated in any terms."

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the revisionist has stated that due to bonafide lapse on the part of learned counsel for the defence, the PW-1, Mohd. Ali could not be cross examined and the PW-2, who is prosecutrix could not be cross examined properly, though she was cross examined whereby some questions were asked from her.

The application under Section 311 Cr.P.C. was filed which was partly allowed by the learned trial court providing opportunity to cross examine PW-1, Mohd. Ali but rejecting the opportunity of cross examination of PW-2/prosecutrix.

The learned trial court has observed that since PW-1 could not be cross examined, therefore, the prayer to that effect is proper but the PW-2 is a prosecutrix, who is minor girl has already been cross examined, therefore, to call her again for the purposes of cross examination would cause prejudice to her.
4.
Learned counsel for the opposite party has supported the order dated 12.06.2024 by submitting that there is no infirmity or illegality in the aforesaid order.

5. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having perused the material available on record,
I am also of the considered opinion that the application under Section 311 Cr.P.C. should not be allowed in a mechanical manner and such application may not be filed to fill up the lacuna.

At the same time, it is also trite that if the valid and proper grounds have been taken in such application and the examination/cross examination of the concerning party is necessary in the ends of justice,
such application may be allowed indicating some reasons thereof.

6. In the present case, learned counsel appearing for the defence has not indicated the specific questions those are left to be asked and it has been simply indicated that some more questions are required to be asked from the prosecutrix.
Such reasons are not sufficient particularity in the present case where the prosecutrix, who is a minor girl has already been cross examined.
7. Therefore, I do not find any infirmity or illegality in the order dated 12.06.2024 passed by learned Special Judge (POCSO Act)/Additional District & Sessions Judge, Ghaziabad.

entities.text: Special Judge (POCSO Act)/Additional District & Sessions Judge, Ghaziabad

sentences.text: 8. Accordingly, the this revision is rejected.
